novelty_flags.label: prop:ganice-loss-separation
novelty_flags.one_line: It calls GANICE an “exact frontier,” but its continuous-conditioning upper theorem is conditional on an implementation-transfer condition and is only matched up to logarithmic and transfer factors.

soundness_flags.one_line: NilesWeedBerthet2022 assumes Besov smoothness of one directly observed density, not uniform-in-x Hölder regularity of conditional-density sections; retag this conditional condition as novel with an applicability justification or cite conditional-density theory that states it.
